definition: Workpal squad compositions adapt public workflows. Role profiles link to their original methods; these authors do not endorse or operate these squads.

squads.name: Discovery & design
squads.mission: Turn a business goal into a design the team can build and verify.
squads.output: Agreed brief, design specification and implementation plan
squads.trigger: A new request, unresolved design decision or incident follow-up needs a clear direction.
squads.humanDecision: Confirm the goal, choose the approach and accept the plan.

squads.name: Engineering delivery
squads.mission: Build the accepted change and resolve findings through review.
capabilities: Implement scoped changes with regression coverage
Resolve review findings and failing checks
squads.output: Reviewable code change, tests and change summary
squads.trigger: An accepted plan or actionable review finding is ready for implementation.
squads.humanDecision: Resolve scope changes and authorize actions outside the agreed task.

handoffs.artifact: Change, intended behavior and check results

squads.name: Verification & review
squads.mission: Give decision owners independent evidence about the proposed change.
capabilities: Review changes against intent and standards
Challenge assumptions and surface unresolved risks
squads.output: Verification evidence, prioritized findings and open decisions
squads.trigger: A change or decision needs an independent review before it proceeds.
squads.humanDecision: Assess unresolved findings; code owners retain the merge decision.

squads.name: Reliability & security
squads.mission: Prepare releases and turn operational evidence into a bounded response.
capabilities: Prepare releases and diagnose pipeline failures
Validate security findings for human triage
squads.output: Release preparation, incident diagnosis and validated findings
squads.trigger: A release request, pipeline failure, configured alert, incident or scheduled scan needs attention.
squads.humanDecision: Authorize production actions, triage security findings and decide on high-impact recovery.

handoffs.artifact: Incident lessons and proposed follow-up work
Changes or recovery proposals needing independent review

squads.name: Research & experiments
squads.mission: Turn an optimization question into a reproducible experiment and an evidence-based decision.
capabilities: Define a baseline and fixed evaluation
Record evidence and retain justified improvements
squads.output: Experiment proposal and results ledger when evidence is supplied
squads.trigger: A measurable research or optimization question needs investigation.
squads.humanDecision: Approve the experiment budget and any execution outside Workpal.

handoffs.artifact: A supported improvement proposal and reproducible evaluation
